color.note: Light theme only for now (dark mode is out of scope until after launch). Warm linen surfaces, deep warm ink, one calm teal for actions, henna and saffron as small lively accents. Every text colour is at least 4.5:1 on every surface it is allowed on.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: warm linen, never pure white, so long sessions are easy on the eyes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, menus and form fields that sit on the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Grouped areas inside a page: filter bars, the measurement guide panel, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows and sections (decorative, not a control border).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and other controls (3.97:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text and headings, on every surface (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, metadata. At least 5.8:1 on every surface, readable for older users.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Thread teal. The one main action per screen, links, selected states and the focus ring. Text in primary is allowed on every surface (5.2:1+).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (6.35:1).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Calm teal tint: selected rows, info notes, the active navigation item background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Henna. Warm highlights used sparingly: a 'new' marker, the active step in a flow, illustrations. Text in accent only on surface, surface-raised, sunken (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (5.73:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Warm tint behind highlighted cards and onboarding tips.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Lively decorative yellow for badges, progress and illustrations. Never text colour; text on it is ink (7.57:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, valid, done. Text and icons (4.6:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings that do not block, e.g. an unusual measurement. Text and icons (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: field errors, delete buttons (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 2px ring.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Kufi Arabic", "Geeza Pro", "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family for Arabic and English (IBM Plex Sans Arabic from Google Fonts covers both). Sizes are one step larger than usual and line heights generous, because Arabic needs room and many users are older.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on landing and empty pages only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: قيسي محيط الصدر عند أعرض نقطة، والشريط موازٍ للأرض.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense tables and secondary paragraphs. Not smaller than this for reading text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, metadata, reference numbers. Never for instructions.

spacing.note: 4px base. Touch targets are at least 44px tall (space-11).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; button horizontal padding is space-4.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page side gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; between form groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any tappable control (buttons, inputs, list rows).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, image frames.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards on the linen surface. Soft and warm, never grey.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and menus.
